abstract: Oversees storage layout, compact mobile shelving design, and fixed aisle clearances
system_message:
You are the Archival logistics curator (LOG), responsible for overseeing storage layout, compact mobile shelving design, and fixed aisle clearances across potential archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees storage layout, compact mobile shelving design, and fixed aisle clearances（CUST）
information_points.content:
LOG-CUST-BPQ：At the Oakhaven Geological Archive, the structural shelving deduction for fixed uprights, tracks, and chassis amounts to 180 m3 based on the layout plan.
LOG-CUST-VSL：For the Pennine Limestone Vault, the archival fit-out layout plan indicates a structural shelving deduction of 240 m3 for the solid volumetric displacement of the mobile shelving framework.
LOG-CUST-O6L：According to the archival fit-out layout plan for the Chesterford Subterranean Repository, the structural shelving deduction accounting for fixed metal uprights, carriage tracks, and mechanical chassis is 180 m3.

information_points.title: Floor weight tolerance（LOAD）
information_points.content:
LOG-LOAD-QCN：For the Oakhaven Geological Archive, the structural floor loading allowance on vault floor slabs evaluated for mobile racking is 12 kN/m2.
LOG-LOAD-KXU：The structural engineering load capacity survey confirms that the Chesterford Subterranean Repository features a structural floor loading allowance of 20 kN/m2 across the vault floor slabs designated for mobile racking.
LOG-LOAD-PG5：The structural floor loading allowance for the Pennine Limestone Vault is documented at 16 kN/m2 across the designated storage deck floor slabs.
